author: Bellular News
description:
Steam hid two indie games behind adults-only restrictions, and cutting content wasn't enough to get one of them back. Nighthawks and Future, No Thanks! only got their ratings changed after the press got involved. What happens to developers who can't get that attention, and the games they decide aren't worth the risk?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
